prompt: A wiry tribal fire shaman in soot-stained ochre leather and crimson warpaint stands in a low side profile facing south-east, both arms thrown forward as he hurls a roaring orange fireball from his bare hands. The fireball slams into a fleeing bandit on the right, who recoils with his clothes catching fire, scorched black and screaming, both figures fully visible head to knee and the same size. The background is a dark obsidian rock canyon at night; the only source of light is the conjured fire, casting harsh red glow on both men.
